title: DUX Result Object
description: A DUX object representing the outcome or consequence of a behavior. Results are the 'what happened next' and can be positive, negative, or neutral.

dux_id.description: Unique identifier for the DUX object, following the format DUX-R-[timestamp]-[uuid]

dux_version.description: The version of the DUX schema.

name.description: A concise, descriptive name for the result.

description.description: A detailed, narrative description of the result, explaining the outcome and its impact.

impact.description: The significance or effect of the result.

evidence.description: A list of direct quotes or references from the source transcript that support the existence and description of this result.

provenance_id.description: The DUX ID of the Provenance object that sources this Result.
